verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a desktop CPU, not a software service or platform, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples does not apply to this kind of product. The evidence covers only hardware specs, Ryzen Master tuning, and performance reviews. Its one passing link to 'Ryzen AI Software For Developers' shows no API reference or runnable examples, so it does not make the axis applicable.
